kafi-2-364-2.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, Book 1, ch. "Breach of Promise", h. 2). Persian: hadithlib (Ayineh-ye Yadha, cites al-Kafi 2/364).

kafi-6-49-3.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 6, ch. "Kindness to Children", h. 3). Persian: hadithlib (cites Kafi 6/49 h3); only spacing typos fixed (و به، وفا کنید، آنها شما).

kafi-2-163-1.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Concern for the Affairs of the Muslims", h. 1). Persian: hadithlib entry citing Bihar 74/337 for the identical wording.

khisal-34.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Ayineh-ye Yadha, al-Khisal p. 34). Cross-checked against thaqalayn al-Khisal (https://thaqalayn.net/hadith/10/3/5/1): same matn.

bihar-43-82.fa_translator: hadithlib.com — چهل حديث « گهرهاى فاطمى » عليها السلام
bihar-43-82.note: Said to Imam al-Hasan (a.s.), who asked why she prayed all night for neighbours and believers but not for herself. Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Chehel hadith "Gohar-ha-ye Fatemi", Bihar 43/82; originally Ilal al-Shara'i 1/181-183 depending on edition). Some editions vowel it الجارَ ثُمَّ الدّارَ (accusative). Persian: commas added only. Arabic: initial "اَل" written plain "ال".

tuhaf-233.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Mizan al-Hikmah, Tuhaf al-Uqul p. 233).

amali-saduq-268.note: Excerpt: the body of a letter the Imam wrote to a man who asked him for "the best of this world and the next" (opening basmala/amma ba'd and closing salam omitted). Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah). Matn verified against thaqalayn al-Amali, majlis 36 h. 14 (https://thaqalayn.net/hadith/29/1/36/14); page/no. per hadithlib's Dunya wa Akhirat (Amali p. 268 h. 293).

tuhaf-248.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Tuhaf al-Uqul p. 248; another hadithlib entry gives p. 177 of a different edition).

kafi-2-602-13.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, Book of the Merit of the Quran, h. 13). Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/602/13).

kafi-2-81-1.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Fulfilling Obligations", h. 1). Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/81/1).

kafi-2-150-4.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Good Relation with Relatives", h. 4). Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/150/4); spacing fixed (دارایی‌ها).

kafi-2-79-1.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Chastity", h. 1; graded hasan ka-l-sahih by Majlisi). Persian: hadithlib (Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/79/1).

kafi-2-507-1.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Praying for Brothers in Their Absence", h. 1). Persian: hadithlib (Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/507/1).

kafi-2-78-14.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. on wara', h. 14; graded sahih). Persian: hadithlib (Chehel Chelcheragh series; no source printed there, matn identical). Page 78 is the standard citation (al-Kafi 2/78/14).

kafi-2-639-5.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, Book of Social Relations, ch. "People Whose Friendship is Necessary", h. 5). Persian: hadithlib (Ayineh-ye Yadha, which cites the same words from Tuhaf al-Uqul p. 366). Page 639 is the standard citation.

amali-saduq-73-10.note: Said by Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) at the time of his death, as narrated by Umm Hamidah. Arabic: thaqalayn al-Amali (unvowelled; editor's footnote marker removed). Persian: hadithlib Chehel hadith "Namaz", whose Arabic reads بصلاته ("his prayer") instead of بالصلاة - same meaning; the same saying is also in al-Kafi 3/270 via Imam al-Kazim (a.s.).

kafi-2-453-2.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Evaluation of Deeds", h. 2; from Abu l-Hasan al-Madi = al-Kazim). Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/453/2).

kafi-2-120-11.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 2, ch. "Friendliness", h. 11). Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 2/120/11).

kafi-1-11-4.note: Arabic: thaqalayn (Kafi 1, Book of Intellect and Ignorance, h. 4). Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Kafi 1/11/4).

uyun-2-24-2.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Muntakhab Mizan al-Hikmah, Uyun 2/24/2). Cross-checked against thaqalayn Uyun vol. 2 (same matn, narrated by Abd al-Azim al-Hasani from Mahmud b. Abi l-Bilad).

tuhaf-457.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Mizan al-Hikmah, Tuhaf al-Uqul p. 457). Urdu says "three things", which the Arabic lists (other narrations add ثلاث خصال explicitly). Urdu edited by reviewer: removed "three things", not in this Arabic.

tuhaf-483.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Dar al-Hadith "Dunya wa Akhirat", Tuhaf al-Uqul p. 483 = Bihar 78/366 h. 6). Persian: leading attribution label removed.

tuhaf-489.note: Arabic+Persian: hadithlib (Mizan al-Hikmah, Tuhaf al-Uqul p. 489).

kamal-485.note: Excerpt from the tawqi' (signed letter) to Ishaq b. Ya'qub, Kamal al-Din ch. 45 (thaqalayn's Kamal al-Din file was empty, so not cross-checked there). Arabic: hadithlib Ayineh-ye Yadha (Kamal al-Din p. 485). Persian: from another hadithlib entry of the same words (Chehel hadith "Entezar") because the Ayineh translation adds "فرج من" not in the Arabic; that Persian renders the end as "this very prayer is the cause of your relief" - an accepted reading.
